note: THE CASE STUDY'S COUNTS, a dated snapshot: counted once from zakholdsworth/chaotic-pendulums-co, at the commit `captured` names, on the day it names. Nothing reads the pendulum's repository - the two stay apart, since the pendulum may be open-sourced or split out. What is read is the one thing its public site says about its releases: /release.json, a mark that changes when a release is cut and says nothing else. `captured.release` is the mark of the release these counts were taken at, and `wherefore check upstream` fails the build when the pendulum's site says another - then a person, or an agent, counts again and rewrites this file, `captured` with it. The page reads the numbers from here and never types them.
